chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 138 – Ji Yichuan Dies, Ji Ning Leaves the Yan Mountains
chapter_meta_description: Ji Yichuan passes from forbidden arts backlash. Before dying, he gives Ji Ning his revenge list. Ji Ning writes the Rainwater Sutra, donates treasures to his clan, and leaves the Yan Mountains with Uncle White.
og_description: After a month of companionship, Ji Yichuan dies in his son’s arms. Ji Ning swears revenge, leaves his clan a new sword manual, and departs the Yan Mountains alone with Whitewater Hound.
twitter_title: Ji Ning’s father dies—the Yan Mountains arc ends with tears and a new beginning
twitter_description: Ji Yichuan’s Zifu collapses from forbidden arts. Before dying, he gives Ji Ning a revenge list. Ji Ning writes the Rainwater Sutra and leaves home.
